Hi Elena —

Welcome, and thanks again for agreeing to get Atlas Components into our vendor system. To keep the kickoff tight, can you please confirm the following two items by end of week?

1) Legal entity name exactly as it should appear on invoices (including DBA if applicable).
2) Primary AP contact for PO routing and remit (name, email, phone).

I attached our VendorSetup_Form (spreadsheet) — if you can fill the highlighted fields (legal name, tax ID, remittance address, ACH details) that will let Finance create the master record and map PO routing. If there are account-level payment rules (net terms, PO mandatory), note them in the "Notes" column.

Attachments: VendorSetup_Form_Atlas.xlsx

Next steps from our side: Marissa will open the vendor record in the ERP and confirm the PO routing channel. Karthik will prepare a short mutual action checklist for the first PO (test PO + invoice) to validate remittance.

Thanks — talk soon.

Marissa —

Thanks. For ERP create I need the following minimal set to avoid back-and-forth:
- Legal name (confirmed)
- Employer identification / tax id (EIN on W-9)
- Remit address (street/city/state/zip)
- Primary AP email (ap@atlascomponents.com)
- Payee type ("Corporation")
- Default payment method (ACH) and whether autopay should be enabled (yes/no)

If banking will be uploaded via secure link we can create the master with a placeholder and flag for pending banking info — that will not block PO creation but will block autopay. Set autopay = no until we have verified banking.

I'll open the master today using a placeholder remit address from the form and mark the record pending banking verification. Please confirm if Atlas wants autopay enabled after verification.

-Markus
